name: Chandrakar Jha
headline: Regional Professional Services & Customer Success Leader | SaaS Consulting | P&L | ASEAN & India | AI Readiness | C-SAT / NPS
about:
Regional Professional Services and Customer Success leader with over 20 years of experience driving SaaS consulting, enterprise implementation, customer growth, and regional P&L performance across ASEAN, India, JAPAC, the Middle East, and Central Asia.
 
In my current role, I head NetSuite Professional Services across ASEAN and India, overseeing consulting sales, delivery execution, revenue forecasting, customer success, team performance, and regional practice growth. My work sits at the intersection of consulting sales, delivery governance, customer outcomes, and long-term account expansion, with close collaboration across licence sales, pre-sales, marketing, alliances, partners, product teams, and senior stakeholders. 
 
Throughout my career, I have focused on building scalable, value-driven consulting practices that deliver measurable business impact. This includes closing the largest Professional Services deal in JAPAC in Q3 FY24, securing approximately US$1.4 million in revenue, building and scaling the NetSuite Professional Services practice across ASEAN and India, and bringing ASEAN to global top-performing status for customer satisfaction. 
 
I am also passionate about preparing consulting teams for the future of work. By embedding AI-enabled ways of working, I have strengthened team productivity by approximately 30% to 40%, enabling faster delivery and more effective customer outcomes. This focus on AI readiness, delivery excellence, and customer success has helped drive one of the highest regional NPS / C-SAT scores globally. 
 
My experience spans Services, FinTech, Automotive, Public Utilities, Oil & Gas, Aviation, Retail, FMCG, E-Commerce, F&B, and Distribution. I enjoy working in roles that combine regional leadership, customer-facing accountability, SaaS transformation, P&L ownership, and the opportunity to build teams that deliver sustainable value.
